s01: The same string can sound different depending on where we pluck it.
Its length and tension have not changed.
Listen to a simple midpoint pluck.
A string has many possible vibration patterns.
The starting shape decides how strongly each one joins the motion.
A midpoint pluck leaves out the even-numbered modes.
Now pluck one third of the way along.
Modes three, six, and nine drop out instead.
Their pattern has a still point exactly where this ideal pluck begins.
The allowed frequencies stay the same.
What changes is their share in the mixture.
Here is the one-third pluck, using the first six modeled modes.
Mathematically, each share includes the sine of mode number times pi times the pluck fraction.
When that sine is zero, that mode is absent.
Real strings and instrument bodies add more detail than these synthesized illustrations.
Where a small gesture begins can change the character of the whole sound.

scenes.narration:
The same string can sound different depending on where we pluck it. Its length and tension have not changed. Listen to a simple midpoint pluck.

A string has many possible vibration patterns. The starting shape decides how strongly each one joins the motion. A midpoint pluck leaves out the even-numbered modes.

Now pluck one third of the way along. Modes three, six, and nine drop out instead. Their pattern has a still point exactly where this ideal pluck begins.

The allowed frequencies stay the same. What changes is their share in the mixture. Here is the one-third pluck, using the first six modeled modes.

Mathematically, each share includes the sine of mode number times pi times the pluck fraction. When that sine is zero, that mode is absent. Real strings and instrument bodies add more detail than these synthesized illustrations. Where a small gesture begins can change the character of the whole sound.
